theme_ko: 시즌 1 · 모니카의 바쁜 주방과 챈들러의 장난

words.ex_en: Joey is so gullible, Chandler fooled him again.
words.ex_ko: 조이는 너무 잘 속아서 챈들러가 또 속였어.

words.def_en: hard to please, especially about food
words.ex_en: Monica is picky about how the plates are arranged.
Don't be sloppy, Joey. Wipe the table.
words.ex_ko: 칠칠맞게 굴지 마, 조이. 테이블 닦아.

words.def_en: tired and stressed from being too busy
words.ex_en: Monica looked frazzled after the dinner rush.
words.ex_ko: 모니카는 저녁 피크 타임 후 녹초가 돼 보였어.

words.ex_en: This soup is bland. Add some salt.
words.ex_ko: 이 수프 싱거워. 소금 좀 넣어.

words.def_en: good at finding ways to solve problems
words.ex_en: Phoebe is resourceful when she has no money.
words.ex_ko: 피비는 돈이 없을 때 수완이 좋아.

words.ex_en: Ross always procrastinates before his lectures.

words.def_en: always telling others what to do
words.ex_en: Rachel, stop being so bossy at work.
words.ex_ko: 레이첼, 일할 때 너무 명령하지 마.

words.ex_en: Ross gave Rachel a sincere apology.
words.ex_ko: 로스는 레이첼에게 진심 어린 사과를 했어.

words.ex_en: Rachel is learning to be frugal.
words.ex_ko: 레이첼은 검소하게 사는 법을 배우는 중이야.

idioms.ex_en: Monica and Phoebe are on the same wavelength.
idioms.scene_ko: 두 친구가 같은 생각을 할 때

idioms.def_en: to do something cheaply or carelessly
idioms.ex_en: Monica never cuts corners in her kitchen.
idioms.ex_ko: 모니카는 주방에서 절대 대충 하지 않아.

idioms.ex_en: Joey and the new girl hit it off.
idioms.ex_ko: 조이와 새로 만난 여자는 금방 친해졌어.
idioms.scene_ko: 처음 만난 사람과 잘 맞을 때

idioms.ex_en: Friends stick together through thick and thin.
idioms.ex_ko: 친구는 좋을 때나 나쁠 때나 함께해.

idioms.ex_en: The plan failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
idioms.ex_ko: 계획이 실패해서 처음부터 다시 해야 해.

idioms.ex_en: Lending Joey money is out of the question.
idioms.ex_ko: 조이에게 돈을 빌려주는 건 절대 안 돼.

idioms.ex_en: Don't pass the buck, Chandler. It was you.

idioms.en: put your foot in your mouth
idioms.ex_en: Chandler put his foot in his mouth again.
Keep your fingers crossed for my audition.
Read between the lines, Ross. She's not interested.
idioms.ex_ko: 로스, 행간을 읽어. 그녀는 관심 없어.

phrasal.ex_en: Mellow out, Monica. It's only dinner.

phrasal.def_en: to join a conversation with a comment
phrasal.ex_en: Phoebe chimed in with her own idea.
Joey, just own up to eating my sandwich.
Chandler's joke made everyone crack up.
Ross slipped up and mentioned the surprise.
phrasal.ex_ko: 로스가 실수로 깜짝 선물을 말해 버렸어.

phrasal.ex_en: Sorry to butt in, but I know that guy.
phrasal.ex_ko: 끼어들어서 미안한데 나 그 사람 알아.

phrasal.ex_en: Rachel spaced out during Ross's story.

phrasal.def_en: to ignore or skip something planned
phrasal.ex_en: Don't blow off dinner with Monica again.
phrasal.ex_ko: 모니카와의 저녁을 또 펑크 내지 마.
